lines.text: The Grecian Jews grumbled because their widows were overlooked, so the Twelve asked for seven men to serve tables.
The group chose Stephen and six others, and the apostles prayed and laid their hands on them.
The word of God spread, and the number of disciples in Damascus grew rapidly.
Freedmen synagogue men could not withstand Stephen's wisdom, so they stirred up the people, elders, and priests.
False witnesses accused Stephen, and everyone in the Sanhedrin saw that his face was like an angel's.
